points.quote: using the output produced by generative AI tools as if it was your own would be in direct contravention of DMU Academic Integrity and Misconduct Policy.
points.anchor: Generative AI: Understanding and Using Tools Like ChatGPT Effectively and Ethically
points.gist: Using generative AI output as if it were your own contravenes the DMU Academic Integrity and Misconduct Policy.

points.quote: If you have been permitted to use AI tools in your work there are ways to acknowledge and referencing their use.
points.gist: Where AI use has been permitted, there are ways to acknowledge and reference it.

points.quote: As AI can be unreliable you also always need to fact check its answers
points.gist: Because AI can be unreliable, you always need to fact check its answers.

points.quote: You need to ask yourself whether you are using AI tools to do the thinking for you or simply to assist you in thinking better.
points.gist: Ask yourself whether AI is doing your thinking or just helping you think better.
